verses.original: לוּא־ קָרַ֤עְתָּ שָׁמַ֙יִם֙ יָרַ֔דְתָּ מִפָּנֶ֖יךָ הָרִ֥ים נָזֹֽלּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: lū- qā·ra‘·tā šā·ma·yim yā·raḏ·tā mip·pā·ne·ḵā hā·rîm nā·zōl·lū
verses.literal: If only You would rend the heavens and come down so that mountains would quake at Your presence
verses.literalPt: Oxalá fenderas tu os céus e desceras, para que tremessem os montes na tua presença,

verses.original: כִּקְדֹ֧חַ אֵ֣שׁ הֲמָסִ֗ים מַ֚יִם תִּבְעֶה־ אֵ֔שׁ לְהוֹדִ֥יעַ שִׁמְךָ֖ לְצָרֶ֑יךָ מִפָּנֶ֖יךָ גּוֹיִ֥ם יִרְגָּֽזוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kiq·ḏō·aḥ ’êš hă·mā·sîm ma·yim tiḇ·‘eh- ’êš lə·hō·w·ḏî·a‘ šim·ḵā lə·ṣā·re·ḵā mip·pā·ne·ḵā gō·w·yim yir·gā·zū
verses.literal: as fire kindles the brushwood and causes the water to boil to make Your name known to Your enemies so that the nations will tremble at Your presence
verses.literalPt: como quando o fogo pega em acendalhas, como quando o fogo faz ferver a água, a fim de fazeres notório o teu nome, aos teus adversários, de sorte que, à tua presença, tremam as nações!

verses.original: בַּעֲשׂוֹתְךָ֥ נוֹרָא֖וֹת לֹ֣א נְקַוֶּ֑ה יָרַ֕דְתָּ מִפָּנֶ֖יךָ הָרִ֥ים נָזֹֽלּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ba·‘ă·śō·wṯ·ḵā nō·w·rā·’ō·wṯ lō nə·qaw·weh yā·raḏ·tā mip·pā·ne·ḵā hā·rîm nā·zōl·lū
verses.literal: When You did awesome works that we did not expect You came down and the mountains trembled at Your presence
verses.literalPt: Quando fizeste coisas terríveis, que não esperávamos, desceste; os montes tremeram à tua presença.

verses.original: וּמֵעוֹלָ֥ם לֹא־ שָׁמְע֖וּ לֹ֣א הֶאֱזִ֑ינוּ עַ֣יִן לֹֽא־ רָאָ֗תָה אֱלֹהִים֙ זוּלָ֣תְךָ֔ יַעֲשֶׂ֖ה לִמְחַכֵּה־ לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mê·‘ō·w·lām lō- šā·mə·‘ū lō he·’ĕ·zî·nū ‘a·yin lō- rā·’ā·ṯāh ’ĕ·lō·hîm zū·lā·ṯə·ḵā ya·‘ă·śeh lim·ḥak·kêh- lōw
verses.literal: From ancient times no one has heard no ear has perceived no eye has seen any God besides You who acts on behalf of those who wait for Him
verses.literalPt: Desde a antiguidade, não têm ouvido os homens, nem com os ouvidos têm percebido, nem tem o olho visto a um Deus fora de ti, o qual opera a favor daquele que o espera.

verses.original: פָּגַ֤עְתָּ אֶת־ שָׂשׂ֙ וְעֹ֣שֵׂה צֶ֔דֶק בִּדְרָכֶ֖יךָ יִזְכְּר֑וּךָ הֵן־ אַתָּ֤ה קָצַ֙פְתָּ֙ וַֽנֶּחֱטָ֔א בָּהֶ֥ם עוֹלָ֖ם וְנִוָּשֵֽׁעַ׃
verses.transliteration: pā·ḡa‘·tā ’eṯ- śāś wə·‘ō·śêh ṣe·ḏeq biḏ·rā·ḵe·ḵā yiz·kə·rū·ḵā hên- ’at·tāh qā·ṣap̄·tā wan·ne·ḥĕ·ṭā bā·hem ‘ō·w·lām wə·niw·wā·šê·a‘
verses.literal: You welcome those who gladly do right who remember Your ways Surely You were angry for we sinned How can we be saved if we remain in our sins
verses.literalPt: Sais ao encontro àquele que se alegra e pratica a justiça, aos que se lembram de ti nos teus caminhos; eis que tu te iraste, e nós pecamos; há muito tempo, temos estado em pecados e havemos de ser salvos?

verses.original: וַנְּהִ֤י כַטָּמֵא֙ כֻּלָּ֔נוּ וּכְבֶ֥גֶד עִדִּ֖ים כָּל־ צִדְקֹתֵ֑ינוּ וַנָּ֤בֶל כֶּֽעָלֶה֙ כֻּלָּ֔נוּ וַעֲוֺנֵ֖נוּ כָּר֥וּחַ יִשָּׂאֻֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wan·nə·hî ḵaṭ·ṭā·mê kul·lā·nū ū·ḵə·ḇe·ḡeḏ ‘id·dîm kāl- ṣiḏ·qō·ṯê·nū wan·nā·ḇel ke·‘ā·leh kul·lā·nū wa·‘ă·wō·nê·nū kā·rū·aḥ yiś·śā·’u·nū
verses.literal: Each of us has become like something unclean and all our righteous acts are like filthy rags we all wither like a leaf and our iniquities carry us away like the wind
verses.literalPt: Pois todos nós somos como o imundo, e todas as nossas justiças, como trapo de imundície; todos nós murchamos como a folha; e as nossas iniquidades, como o vento, nos arrebatam.

verses.original: וְאֵין־ קוֹרֵ֣א בְשִׁמְךָ֔ מִתְעוֹרֵ֖ר לְהַחֲזִ֣יק בָּ֑ךְ כִּֽי־ הִסְתַּ֤רְתָּ פָנֶ֙יךָ֙ מִמֶּ֔נּוּ וַתְּמוּגֵ֖נוּ בְּיַד־ עֲוֺנֵֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ên- qō·w·rê ḇə·šim·ḵā miṯ·‘ō·w·rêr lə·ha·ḥă·zîq bāḵ kî- his·tar·tā p̄ā·ne·ḵā mim·men·nū wat·tə·mū·ḡê·nū bə·yaḏ- ‘ă·wō·nê·nū
verses.literal: No one calls on Your name or strives to take hold of You For You have hidden Your face from us and delivered us into the hand of our iniquity
verses.literalPt: Não há quem invoque o teu nome, quem se desperte para pegar de ti, porque escondeste de nós a tua face e nos consumiste pelas nossas iniquidades.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אָבִ֣ינוּ אָ֑תָּה אֲנַ֤חְנוּ הַחֹ֙מֶר֙ וְאַתָּ֣ה יֹצְרֵ֔נוּ וּמַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יָדְךָ֖ כֻּלָּֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh Yah·weh ’ā·ḇî·nū ’āt·tāh ’ă·naḥ·nū ha·ḥō·mer wə·’at·tāh yō·ṣə·rê·nū ū·ma·‘ă·śêh yā·ḏə·ḵā kul·lā·nū
verses.literal: But now O LORD You are our Father we are the clay and You are the potter we are all the work of Your hand
verses.literalPt: Mas, agora, Jeová, tu és nosso Pai; nós somos o barro, e tu, o nosso oleiro; e todos nós somos obra das tuas mãos.

verses.original: אַל־ תִּקְצֹ֤ף יְהוָה֙ עַד־ מְאֹ֔ד וְאַל־ לָעַ֖ד תִּזְכֹּ֣ר עָוֺ֑ן הֵ֥ן הַבֶּט־ נָ֖א עַמְּךָ֥ כֻלָּֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tiq·ṣōp̄ Yah·weh ‘aḏ- mə·’ōḏ wə·’al- lā·‘aḏ tiz·kōr ‘ā·wōn hên hab·beṭ- nā ‘am·mə·ḵā ḵul·lā·nū
verses.literal: Do not be angry O LORD beyond measure do not remember our iniquity forever Oh look upon us we pray we are all Your people
verses.literalPt: Não te agastes muito, Jeová, nem para sempre te lembres da iniquidade; olha, te pedimos, todos nós somos o teu povo.

verses.original: עָרֵ֥י קָדְשְׁךָ֖ הָי֣וּ מִדְבָּ֑ר צִיּוֹן֙ מִדְבָּ֣ר הָיָ֔תָה יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם שְׁמָמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·rê qāḏ·šə·ḵā hā·yū miḏ·bār ṣî·yō·wn miḏ·bār hā·yā·ṯāh yə·rū·šā·lim šə·mā·māh
verses.literal: Your holy cities have become a wilderness Zion has become a wasteland and Jerusalem a desolation
verses.literalPt: As tuas cidades santas tornaram-se um deserto; Sião está feita um deserto, Jerusalém, uma desolação.

verses.original: בֵּ֧ית קָדְשֵׁ֣נוּ וְתִפְאַרְתֵּ֗נוּ אֲשֶׁ֤ר הִֽלְל֙וּךָ֙ אֲבֹתֵ֔ינוּ הָיָ֖ה לִשְׂרֵ֣פַת אֵ֑שׁ וְכָל־ מַחֲמַדֵּ֖ינוּ הָיָ֥ה לְחָרְבָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bêṯ qā·ḏə·šê·nū wə·ṯip̄·’ar·tê·nū ’ă·šer hil·lū·ḵā ’ă·ḇō·ṯê·nū hā·yāh liś·rê·p̄aṯ ’êš wə·ḵāl ma·ḥă·mad·dê·nū hā·yāh lə·ḥā·rə·bāh
verses.literal: Our holy and beautiful temple where our fathers praised You has been burned with fire and all that was dear to us lies in ruins
verses.literalPt: A nossa santa e gloriosa casa, em que nossos pais te louvaram, está queimada a fogo; e todas as nossas coisas deleitáveis estão consumidas.

verses.original: הַעַל־ אֵ֥לֶּה תִתְאַפַּ֖ק יְהוָ֑ה תֶּחֱשֶׁ֥ה וּתְעַנֵּ֖נוּ עַד־ מְאֹֽד׃ס
verses.transliteration: ha·‘al- ’êl·leh ṯiṯ·’ap·paq Yah·weh te·ḥĕ·šeh ū·ṯə·‘an·nê·nū ‘aḏ- mə·’ōḏ
verses.literal: After all this O LORD will You restrain Yourself Will You keep silent and afflict us beyond measure
verses.literalPt: Acaso, conter-te-ás, Jeová, apesar disso? Ficarás calado e afligir-nos-ás até as últimas?
